text:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding Ecliptic LoRA (epilogue-7b-lora-v1) into epilogue-7b-int8 baseline. Quick eval pack uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/epilogue/ecliptic-lite. Ran an initial smoke on a customer subset.

sam: Can you paste the smoke numbers? Any tokenization mismatches or softprompt issues? @maria

maria: Short summary: safety checks passed, median latency +3ms, perplexity delta +0.6% vs baseline, invoice-amount recall down 1.7% on the int8 merge. No tokenizer remap required. Prompt used: "extract invoice total" (see pack).

jia: Do we have kv-cache alignment tests? Sometimes LoRA merges + int8 kernels shift KV positions and break long-ctx behavior.

maria: Ran kv-offsets up to 2048 ctx — stable. Quick command I ran:
```
redwood-eval run --suite quick-invoice --model epilogue-7b-int8+ecliptic-v1 --batch 16 --quant int8
# result summary: pass: 92/100, amount_recall: 98.3%, latency_p50: 54ms
```

nate: @maria nice. Any output-format regressions? Customer requires two-decimal enforcement (e.g., 1234.00).

maria: Found small formatting drift: 4/100 cases returned "USD 1,234" instead of "1234.00". Likely a subtle tokenization/whitespace change in the merged head. Plan: add a postprocess normalizer in the eval harness and re-run. Tokenizer config change probably not needed unless drift persists.

deploy-bot: Canary requested: epilogue-7b-int8+ecliptic-v1 -> pool "dedicated-ecliptic-canary" at 10% for 1h. Status: scheduled.

maria: I'll patch the eval pack with the normalizer and re-run overnight. If amount_recall stays <2% drop and formatting fixes to <1% failures, we approve full merge and rollout. Thanks :thumbsup:
